rejected_rule.statement: A part payment of a debt sued for prevents the statutory bar from attaching and can take the case out of prescription.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "It has undoubtedly been held by our Courts that a part payment of the debt sued for prevents the statutory bar from attaching (cf. Sathappa Chetty v. Ramen Chetty [ 15 S. C. C. 6.2. ])."
